items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of electric wheelchair
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.
items.computation: Letter (Bescheid) dated Friday 20.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the printed date is the posting day. The Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse is a statutory health insurer, a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, so delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days: 21.11 (Sat)=day1, 22.11 (Sun)=day2, 23.11 (Mon)=day3, 24.11 (Tue)=day4 → deemed delivered 24.11.2026. For such bodies the delivery day does not move even if it falls on a weekend/holiday (it is a Tuesday here anyway). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after delivery (day of delivery not counted, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / §§ 187, 188 BGB) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 24.12.2026. 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (only 25/26 Dec are holidays) and is not a Saturday or Sunday, so the deadline does not shift (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).
